lines.say: Ammi's biryani recipe has little notes everywhere. Don't burn the onions!
lines.cap: Ammi's biryani recipe has little notes everywhere. Don't burn the onions!

lines.say: Code needs notes too! In Python, they're called comments!
lines.cap: Code needs notes too! In Python, they're called comments!

lines.say: A hash sign starts a comment. Python skips it completely!
lines.cap: A # starts a comment. Python skips it completely!

lines.say: So the computer never reads it?
lines.cap: So the computer never reads it?

lines.say: Never! Comments are notes for humans. Even at the end of a line!
lines.cap: Never! Comments are notes for humans. Even at the end of a line!

lines.say: Pro trick! Put a hash in front of code, and it switches off!
lines.cap: Pro trick! Put a # in front of code, and it switches off!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Yes! The hash turned the first line into a comment!
lines.cap: Yes! The # turned the first line into a comment!
